name: comic-panel
description: Comic book panel layout — white background, thick black borders, Comic Neue font, speech-bubble-heavy. Optimized for dialogue-driven stories, character interactions, and slice-of-life content.

scriptStyle.narrator: warm conversational storyteller with light humor — like a friend recapping a wild day
scriptStyle.register: natural, character-driven, dialogue-heavy with room for visual gags
patterns: heavy use of dialogue — let characters talk to each other, not just narration
panel-transition pacing — each scene beat maps to a visual panel
reaction shots as punchlines — show the face, let silence do the work
inner monologue moments ('Meanwhile, Dave was having an existential crisis')
sound effects in narration ('And then — CRASH — the whole thing fell apart')
alternating close and wide shots for rhythm
antiPatterns: monotone pacing — mix fast dialogue with slow reaction shots
telling when you could show with a panel
too many characters in one scene (2-3 max for clarity)
